test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to fill the blank part of the sentence. If the sentence is already correct, select 'No substitution required'.
Hardly had the scientist presented his theory when critics called it ___ absurd theory of the decade.
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**', i.e. 'the most'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The blank requires a superlative form to describe the theory as the "most absurd theory of the decade."
 
• The word **"the most"** is used as a superlative form to indicate the highest degree of absurdity in comparison to other theories.
 
• **Option 1 ("the more")** is incorrect because "more" is comparative, not super
